calculation_handling.description: Short-term bicycle parking spaces may be reduced by up to half the amount required by 230.5.10.1(5)(A) or (B), rounded down, under the payment-in-lieu route.
calculation_handling.gaps: There is no target for a permitted reduction in bicycle parking spaces, and the base requirement depends on the Bicycle Zone map, which is not held.

units.disclosure: Under the payment-in-lieu route, the short-term bicycle parking spaces required for dwelling units may be reduced by up to half, rounded down. This reduction is not modelled.

calculation_handling.description: Long-term bicycle parking spaces may be reduced by up to half the amount required by 230.5.10.1(5)(A) or (B), rounded down, under the payment-in-lieu route.
calculation_handling.gaps: There is no target for a permitted reduction in bicycle parking spaces, and the base requirement depends on the Bicycle Zone map, which is not held.

units.disclosure: Under the payment-in-lieu route, the long-term bicycle parking spaces required for dwelling units may be reduced by up to half, rounded down. This reduction is not modelled.

calculation_handling.description: For each bicycle parking space reduced, the owner or occupant must pay a payment-in-lieu to the City of Toronto.
calculation_handling.gaps: A payment obligation is not a numeric limit and has no vocabulary requirement.

units.disclosure: Each bicycle parking space reduced under this route requires a payment-in-lieu to the City of Toronto. This obligation is not modelled.

calculation_handling.description: The owner or occupant must enter into an agreement with the City of Toronto under Section 40 of the Planning Act.
calculation_handling.gaps: An agreement obligation is not a numeric limit and has no vocabulary requirement.

units.disclosure: The owner or occupant must enter into a Section 40 Planning Act agreement with the City of Toronto to use the payment-in-lieu route. This obligation is not modelled.

calculation_handling.description: When 230.5.10.1(5) spaces are reduced, the spaces required by 230.5.1.10(7), (12), (13) and (15) are calculated from the reduced number.
calculation_handling.gaps: Depends on the unmodelled payment-in-lieu reduction.

230.5.10.20(1).explanation: The bicycle parking spaces required for dwelling units may be reduced through payment-in-lieu: up to half of the short-term spaces and up to half of the long-term spaces (each rounded down) may be dropped, the owner or occupant pays the City for each space dropped, and signs a Section 40 Planning Act agreement. Related facility requirements are then worked out from the reduced number of spaces.
